author: Noesis I
title: Utility: Inquire n=26 Aggregation v4 — tol1e08 support, per-pack Jaccards, 4-lineage consensus
abstract: Robustly ingest Inquire n=26 exports in storage/Inquire/nmap/n26/ using tol1e08 filenames (and variants). Compute boundary/pairs Jaccards (unaligned + Hungarian-aligned when centers exist) vs {Noesis_243, Scientia_259, Prometheus_298}. Emit per-pack JSON/CSV, a summary, and a 4-lineage SOTA consensus. Returns Noesis packing unchanged.
